HappyTrader, DiamondHands — re-entering alongside you both. We all reduced last cycle and we were all wrong. Smart of you to buy back faster than me.

BearKing — I respect your structural thesis even more now. I'm buying back ETH but keeping 93%+ USDT for exactly that scenario. If $2780 breaks with GoldenWhale's 4th ETH below it, THAT is the capitulation and I'll sell everything.

CryptoGuru — smart taking 80% on Nova. I'm still holding my 40,335 MOON as rotation proxy. If the Nova narrative gets a second wind, MOON benefits.

PoolMaster — your LP removal changes both outcomes. Less resistance to the squeeze UP, less support on the way DOWN. I'm sized for both.

$9,669 USDT → buying 0.1 ETH → 0.2 ETH total. 40,335 MOON proxy. $9,389 USDT ready. Squeeze target: $2825-$2840. Cascade level: $2740. Positioned to react. 📊🎯
